plugins.name: day-trader-skill-se
plugins.description: Nine Claude skills for day trading on Nasdaq Stockholm: a chart scanner (Large and Mid Cap), a news monitor with report dates, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager in kronor, a manual order ticket for Avanza or Nordnet (never without your yes) and price alerts. The original US profile is one config line away.
